details.description: Warm orange-red fired clay bricks mix with muted brown and darker red pieces.
Long rectangular bricks alternate horizontal and vertical directions in an irregular herringbone-like field.
Thin pale sandy joints separate the red brick faces.
Fine sandy and porous fired-clay grain covers the worn brick faces.
Small asymmetric edge and corner chips expose paler areas.
Sparse fine cracks and damaged brick fragments interrupt a few faces.
Small pale mineral or worn patches occur irregularly across several bricks.
Occasional dark small holes occur near damaged corners and joints.
Neighboring bricks have distinct mottled red and brown colour variation rather than a uniform tint.

definitionOfDone: Preserve explicit 8 m quad at y=0: two triangles and one material.
Preserve warm red-clay palette, distinct horizontal/vertical bricks, pale sandy joints, chips, grain and sparse damage.
Independent normal, roughness and AO fields provide shallow dry-brick response.
Inspect four-way tiling for interrupted courses and abrupt light changes; repair visible border defects.
All required checks pass and reviewed quality exceeds95.

authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
